var int   lastEqlHighTime = na
var int   lastEqlLowTime  = na
var int   lastEqlHighBar  = na
var int   lastEqlLowBar   = na

eqlDetectedHigh = false
eqlDetectedLow  = false

if showEQL and eqlNewPivot
    if eqlPivotHi
        if not na(lastEqlHigh) and math.abs(lastEqlHigh - high[eqlLength]) < eqlThresh * atrVal
            line.new(lastEqlHighTime, lastEqlHigh, time[eqlLength], high[eqlLength], xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR, style=line.style_dotted)
            lp = math.round((lastEqlHighBar + bar_index[eqlLength]) / 2)
            label.new(lp, lastEqlHigh, 'EQH', color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
            eqlDetectedHigh := true
        lastEqlHigh     := high[eqlLength]
        lastEqlHighTime := time[eqlLength]
        lastEqlHighBar  := bar_index[eqlLength]
    if eqlPivotLow
        if not na(lastEqlLow) and math.abs(lastEqlLow - low[eqlLength]) < eqlThresh * atrVal
            line.new(lastEqlLowTime, lastEqlLow, time[eqlLength], low[eqlLength], xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL, style=line.style_dotted)
            lp = math.round((lastEqlLowBar + bar_index[eqlLength]) / 2)
            label.new(lp, lastEqlLow, 'EQL', color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)
            eqlDetectedLow := true
        lastEqlLow     := low[eqlLength]
        lastEqlLowTime := time[eqlLength]
        lastEqlLowBar  := bar_index[eqlLength]

// ── Strong / Weak High/Low (LuxAlgo) ─────────────────────────
if showStrWeak and barstate.islast and not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot)
    rightBar = last_bar_time + 20 * (time - time[1])
    line.new(trailTopTime, trailTop, rightBar, trailTop, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR)
    label.new(rightBar, trailTop, swTrend == -1 ? 'Strong High' : 'Weak High', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny)
    line.new(trailBotTime, trailBot, rightBar, trailBot, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL)
    label.new(rightBar, trailBot, swTrend == 1 ? 'Strong Low' : 'Weak Low', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)

// ── Premium / Discount Zones (LuxAlgo) ───────────────────────
if showPD and not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot) and barstate.islast
    eqLvl   = math.avg(trailTop, trailBot)
    premTop = trailTop
    premBot = 0.95*trailTop + 0.05*trailBot
    discTop = 0.95*trailBot + 0.05*trailTop
    discBot = trailBot
    eqTop   = 0.525*trailTop + 0.475*trailBot
    eqBot   = 0.525*trailBot + 0.475*trailTop
    rBar    = last_bar_time
    box.new(trailTopBar, premTop, bar_index+10, premBot, bgcolor=C_PREM, border_color=color(na))
    box.new(trailTopBar, eqTop,   bar_index+10, eqBot,   bgcolor=C_EQ,   border_color=color(na))
    box.new(trailTopBar, discTop, bar_index+10, discBot, bgcolor=C_DISC, border_color=color(na))
    lp = math.round(0.5 * (trailTopBar + last_bar_index))
    label.new(lp, premTop, 'Premium',     color=color(na), textcolor=#E24B4A, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
    label.new(lp, eqLvl,  'Equilibrium', color=color(na), textcolor=#888780,  style=label.style_label_left,  size=size.tiny)
    label.new(lp, discBot,'Discount',     color=color(na), textcolor=#1D9E75, style=label.style_label_up,   size=size.tiny)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 3 — IBT GAP DETECTION ENGINE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Gap threshold using LuxAlgo's ATR-based auto-threshold
barDeltaPct = (close - open) / (open * 100)
cumThresh   = fvgAutoThresh ? ta.cum(math.abs(barDeltaPct)) / bar_index * 2 : 0.0

// ── BAG: Body breaks prior extreme ───────────────────────────
bullBAG = low > high[2] and close[1] > high[2]
bearBAG = high < low[2] and close[1] < low[2]

// Double BAG detection
doubleBullBAG = bullBAG and low[1] > high[3] and close[2] > high[3]
doubleBearBAG = bearBAG and high[1] < low[3] and close[2] < low[3]
validBullBAG  = bullBAG and not doubleBullBAG
validBearBAG  = bearBAG and not doubleBearBAG

// ── FVG: Gap exists, wick only ────────────────────────────────
bullFVGraw = low > high[2] and not bullBAG
bearFVGraw = high < low[2] and not bearBAG

// ── CFVG: Color change on FVG ────────────────────────────────
bullCFVG = bullFVGraw and close > open and close[1] < open[1]
bearCFVG = bearFVGraw and close < open and close[1] > open[1]
cleanBullFVG = bullFVGraw and not bullCFVG
cleanBearFVG = bearFVGraw and not bearCFVG

// ── Impulse / Manipulation Gap detection ─────────────────────
impulseUp = close[1]>open[1] and close[2]>open[2] and close[3]>open[3] and close[4]>open[4]
impulseDn = close[1]<open[1] and close[2]<open[2] and close[3]<open[3] and close[4]<open[4]
isMG      = (bullBAG and impulseUp) or (bearBAG and impulseDn)

// ── Gap background colors ─────────────────────────────────────
bgcolor(showBAG  and validBullBAG and not isMG  ? color.new(C_BAG,  85) : na, title='Bull BAG')
bgcolor(showBAG  and validBearBAG and not isMG  ? color.new(C_BAG,  85) : na, title='Bear BAG')
bgcolor(showCFVG and (bullCFVG or bearCFVG)     ? color.new(C_CFVG, 80) : na, title='CFVG')
bgcolor(showFVG  and (cleanBullFVG or cleanBearFVG) ? color.new(C_FVG, 88) : na, title='FVG')
bgcolor(showMG   and isMG                       ? color.new(C_MG,   80) : na, title='MG Skip')
bgcolor(doubleBullBAG or doubleBearBAG          ? color.new(#888780, 85): na, title='Double BAG Wait')

// ─── MG marker ───────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(showMG and isMG, title='MG Skip', location=location.abovebar, color=#E24B4A, style=shape.xcross, size=size.small, text='MG')

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 4 — LIQUIDITY SWEEP DETECTION (IBT)
//  Valid sweep: wick pierces swing level + body closes back
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Use LuxAlgo's swing pivots for sweep reference
bullSweep = not na(swLow)  and low  < swLow  and close > swLow
bearSweep = not na(swHigh) and high > swHigh and close < swHigh

// IFC candle: large wick, tiny body (< 25% of range)
bodySize  = math.abs(close - open)
rangeSize = high - low
ifcShape  = rangeSize > 0 and (bodySize / rangeSize) < 0.25 and rangeSize > atrVal * 0.8
bullIFC   = ifcShape and low < low[1] and close > open
bearIFC   = ifcShape and high > high[1] and close < open

// Sweep memory: any sweep in last N bars
bullSweepRecent = ta.barssince(bullSweep) <= sweepMem
bearSweepRecent = ta.barssince(bearSweep) <= sweepMem

// Ranging: both sweeps active recently = skip
ranging = bullSweepRecent and bearSweepRecent

// Sweep markers
plotshape(bullSweep, title='Bull Sweep', location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(#534AB7,0), style=shape.triangleup,   size=size.tiny, text='SW↑')
plotshape(bearSweep, title='Bear Sweep', location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(#534AB7,0), style=shape.triangledown, size=size.tiny, text='SW↓')
plotshape(bullIFC and bullSweep, title='Bull IFC', location=location.belowbar, color=#534AB7, style=shape.diamond, size=size.small, text='IFC')
plotshape(bearIFC and bearSweep, title='Bear IFC', location=location.abovebar, color=#534AB7, style=shape.diamond, size=size.small, text='IFC')

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 5 — PREMIUM / DISCOUNT ZONE HELPER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pdMid     = not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot) ? math.avg(trailTop, trailBot) : na
inDiscount = not na(pdMid) and close < pdMid
inPremium  = not na(pdMid) and close > pdMid

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 6 — ORDER FLOW DIRECTION BIAS
//  Count directional gaps in last 10 bars
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
bullGapCount = 0
bearGapCount = 0
for k = 1 to 10
    if low[k] > high[k+2]
        bullGapCount += 1
    if high[k] < low[k+2]
        bearGapCount += 1

ofDir = bullGapCount > bearGapCount * 1.5 ? 1 : bearGapCount > bullGapCount * 1.5 ? -1 : 0

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 7 — IBT SIGNAL SCORING
//  Score 0-9. Only fire signals above minScore.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// A-class: BAG or CFVG (3 pts), B-class: FVG (1 pt)
bullGapScore = validBullBAG or bullCFVG ? 3 : cleanBullFVG ? 1 : 0
bearGapScore = validBearBAG or bearCFVG ? 3 : cleanBearFVG ? 1 : 0

// Sweep presence (+2 if IFC, +1 if plain sweep)
bullSweepScore = bullSweepRecent ? (bullIFC ? 2 : 1) : 0
bearSweepScore = bearSweepRecent ? (bearIFC ? 2 : 1) : 0

// BOS/CHoCH alignment from LuxAlgo structure engine (+1)
bullStructScore = (bosBull or inBosBull or chochBull or inChochBull) ? 1 : 0
bearStructScore = (bosBear or inBosBear or chochBear or inChochBear) ? 1 : 0

// Premium/Discount zone (+1)
bullPDScore = inDiscount ? 1 : 0
bearPDScore = inPremium  ? 1 : 0

// Order Flow alignment (+1)
bullOFScore = ofDir == 1 ? 1 : 0
bearOFScore = ofDir == -1 ? 1 : 0

// EQL adds urgency context (equal level swept = stronger)
bullEQLScore = eqlDetectedLow and bullSweepRecent ? 1 : 0
bearEQLScore = eqlDetectedHigh and bearSweepRecent ? 1 : 0

// Total scores
bullScore = bullGapScore + bullSweepScore + bullStructScore + bullPDScore + bullOFScore + bullEQLScore
bearScore = bearGapScore + bearSweepScore + bearStructScore + bearPDScore + bearOFScore + bearEQLScore

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 8 — SIGNAL FILTERS & FINAL ENTRY CONDITIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sweepFilter = sweepReqd ? bullSweepRecent : true
aFilter     = aClassOnly ? (validBullBAG or bullCFVG) : (validBullBAG or bullCFVG or cleanBullFVG)

// BUY A-Class: BAG/CFVG + sweep + structural alignment + not MG + not ranging + score
buyA = showSignals
     and (validBullBAG or bullCFVG)
     and bullSweepRecent
     and not isMG and not ranging
     and (swTrend == 1 or inTrend == 1)
     and bullScore >= minScore

// SELL A-Class
sellA = showSignals
      and (validBearBAG or bearCFVG)
      and bearSweepRecent
      and not isMG and not ranging
      and (swTrend == -1 or inTrend == -1)
      and bearScore >= minScore

// BUY B-Class: FVG + sweep + score (if A-class only is off)
buyB = showSignals and not aClassOnly
     and cleanBullFVG
     and bullSweepRecent
     and not isMG and not ranging
     and bullScore >= minScore

// SELL B-Class
sellB = showSignals and not aClassOnly
      and cleanBearFVG
      and bearSweepRecent
      and not isMG and not ranging
      and bearScore >= minScore

// ── Signal labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────
gapTypeBull = validBullBAG ? 'BAG' : bullCFVG ? 'CFVG' : 'FVG'
gapTypeBear = validBearBAG ? 'BAG' : bearCFVG ? 'CFVG' : 'FVG'

if buyA
    l = label.new(bar_index, low, 'BUY\n' + gapTypeBull + (showScore ? '\n★' + str.tostring(bullScore) : ''),
      color=#1D9E75, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.normal)
if sellA
    l = label.new(bar_index, high, 'SELL\n' + gapTypeBear + (showScore ? '\n★' + str.tostring(bearScore) : ''),
      color=#E24B4A, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)
if buyB
    l = label.new(bar_index, low, 'buy\n' + gapTypeBull + (showScore ? '\n' + str.tostring(bullScore) : ''),
      color=color.new(#1D9E75,40), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)
if sellB
    l = label.new(bar_index, high, 'sell\n' + gapTypeBear + (showScore ? '\n' + str.tostring(bearScore) : ''),
      color=color.new(#E24B4A,40), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// Double BAG warning label
if doubleBullBAG or doubleBearBAG
    label.new(bar_index, close, 'Double BAG\nWait 50%', color=color.new(#888780,30), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 9 — INFO TABLE (top-right)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 9, bgcolor=color.new(#2C2C2A,10), border_width=1, border_color=color.new(#888780,50))

if showTable and barstate.islast
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, 'IBT-SMC',    text_color=color.white,  text_size=size.small, bgcolor=#1D9E75)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, '[PrasaD]',   text_color=color.white,  text_size=size.small, bgcolor=#1D9E75)

    swTrendStr  = swTrend == 1 ? '↑ UP' : swTrend == -1 ? '↓ DOWN' : '—'
    swTrendCol  = swTrend == 1 ? #1D9E75 : swTrend == -1 ? #E24B4A : #888780
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, 'Swing Trend',  text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, swTrendStr,     text_color=swTrendCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    inTrendStr  = inTrend == 1 ? '↑ UP' : inTrend == -1 ? '↓ DOWN' : '—'
    inTrendCol  = inTrend == 1 ? #1D9E75 : inTrend == -1 ? #E24B4A : #888780
    table.cell(t, 0, 2, 'Int. Trend',   text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, inTrendStr,     text_color=inTrendCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    pdStr  = inDiscount ? 'Discount ✓' : inPremium ? 'Premium ✓' : 'Equilibrium'
    pdCol  = inDiscount ? #1D9E75 : inPremium ? #E24B4A : #888780
    table.cell(t, 0, 3, 'P/D Zone',     text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 3, pdStr,          text_color=pdCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    ofStr  = ofDir == 1 ? 'Bull Flow ↑' : ofDir == -1 ? 'Bear Flow ↓' : 'Ranging'
    ofCol  = ofDir == 1 ? #1D9E75 : ofDir == -1 ? #E24B4A : #BA7517
    table.cell(t, 0, 4, 'Order Flow',   text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 4, ofStr,          text_color=ofCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    swpStr = bullSweepRecent ? 'Bull ✓' : bearSweepRecent ? 'Bear ✓' : 'None'
    swpCol = bullSweepRecent ? #1D9E75 : bearSweepRecent ? #E24B4A : #888780
    table.cell(t, 0, 5, 'Sweep',        text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 5, swpStr,         text_color=swpCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    mgStr  = isMG ? '⚠ SKIP' : 'Clear'
    mgCol  = isMG ? #E24B4A : #1D9E75
    table.cell(t, 0, 6, 'MG Zone',      text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 6, mgStr,          text_color=mgCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    mktStr = ranging ? 'RANGING ⚡' : 'Trending'
    mktCol = ranging ? #BA7517 : color.white
    table.cell(t, 0, 7, 'Market',       text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 7, mktStr,         text_color=mktCol, text_size=size.tiny)

    sigStr = buyA  ? '▲ BUY (A)  ★' + str.tostring(bullScore) :
             sellA ? '▼ SELL (A) ★' + str.tostring(bearScore) :
             buyB  ? '▲ buy (B)  ' + str.tostring(bullScore) :
             sellB ? '▼ sell (B) ' + str.tostring(bearScore) : 'Waiting...'
    sigCol = (buyA or buyB) ? #1D9E75 : (sellA or sellB) ? #E24B4A : #888780
    table.cell(t, 0, 8, 'Signal',       text_color=color.new(#D3D1C7,0), text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(t, 1, 8, sigStr,         text_color=sigCol, text_size=size.tiny)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 10 — ALERTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// IBT Entry Signals
alertcondition(buyA,  'IBT ▲ BUY A-Class',  'IBT A-Class BUY — BAG/CFVG + Sweep + Structure. Confirm T1 clear.')
alertcondition(sellA, 'IBT ▼ SELL A-Class', 'IBT A-Class SELL — BAG/CFVG + Sweep + Structure. Confirm T1 clear.')
alertcondition(buyB,  'IBT ▲ buy B-Class',  'IBT B-Class BUY — FVG + Sweep. Lower confidence. Manual confirm.')
alertcondition(sellB, 'IBT ▼ sell B-Class', 'IBT B-Class SELL — FVG + Sweep. Lower confidence. Manual confirm.')

// Structure alerts (from LuxAlgo engine)
alertcondition(bosBull  or inBosBull,   'IBT BOS Bullish',  'Bullish Break of Structure confirmed.')
alertcondition(bosBear  or inBosBear,   'IBT BOS Bearish',  'Bearish Break of Structure confirmed.')
alertcondition(chochBull or inChochBull,'IBT CHoCH Bullish','Bullish Change of Character — possible reversal.')
alertcondition(chochBear or inChochBear,'IBT CHoCH Bearish','Bearish Change of Character — possible reversal.')

// Sweep & context alerts
alertcondition(bullSweep, 'IBT Liquidity Sweep ↑', 'Bullish liquidity sweep. Watch for reversal setup.')
alertcondition(bearSweep, 'IBT Liquidity Sweep ↓', 'Bearish liquidity sweep. Watch for reversal setup.')
alertcondition(isMG,      'IBT ⚠ MG Zone — Skip', 'Manipulation Gap. Do NOT trade this candle.')
alertcondition(ranging,   'IBT Ranging Market',    'Both sweeps active. Market ranging. Stay out.')
alertcondition(eqlDetectedHigh, 'IBT Equal Highs', 'Equal Highs detected. Dense liquidity above.')
alertcondition(eqlDetectedLow,  'IBT Equal Lows',  'Equal Lows detected. Dense liquidity below.')

{"language": "plaintext", "code": "// IBT Binary SMC — PrasaD | Built on LuxAlgo SMC structural engine
// License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 | Structural engine © LuxAlgo (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)
// IBT entry logic layer © PrasaD / KSM X Tech
// LuxAlgo original: https://www.tradingview.com/v/CnB3fSph/
//@version=5
indicator('IBT Binary SMC [PrasaD]', 'IBT-SMC', overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500, max_boxes_count=500, max_bars_back=500)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 1 — INPUTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

grpCore  = '⚙ IBT Core'
grpSMC   = '📐 SMC Structure (LuxAlgo Engine)'
grpGaps  = '📊 Gaps'
grpOB    = '🟧 Order Blocks'
grpEQ    = '⚖ Equal H/L'
grpPD    = '🎯 Premium/Discount'
grpSig   = '✅ IBT Entry Signals'
grpVis   = '🎨 Visuals'

// ── SMC Structure ─────────────────────────────────────────────
swingsLen       = input.int(50,  'Swing Pivot Length',      group=grpSMC, minval=10)
showBOS         = input.bool(true, 'Show BOS/CHoCH (Swing)', group=grpSMC)
showInternal    = input.bool(true, 'Show Internal Structure', group=grpSMC)
showSwingPts    = input.bool(false, 'Show HH/HL/LL/LH Labels', group=grpSMC)
showStrWeak     = input.bool(true, 'Show Strong/Weak H/L',  group=grpSMC)
colorMode       = input.string('Colored', 'Color Theme', group=grpSMC, options=['Colored','Monochrome'])

// ── Gaps ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
showFVG         = input.bool(true,  'Show FVG Zones',        group=grpGaps)
showBAG         = input.bool(true,  'Show BAG Zones',        group=grpGaps)
showCFVG        = input.bool(true,  'Show CFVG Zones',       group=grpGaps)
showMG          = input.bool(true,  'Show MG (Skip Zone)',   group=grpGaps)
fvgAutoThresh   = input.bool(true,  'FVG Auto-Threshold',    group=grpGaps)
fvgExtend       = input.int(3,      'Extend Gap Boxes (bars)',group=grpGaps, minval=0)

// ── Order Blocks ──────────────────────────────────────────────
showOB          = input.bool(true,  'Show Order Blocks',     group=grpOB)
obCount         = input.int(5,      'OB Count',              group=grpOB, minval=1, maxval=10)
obFilter        = input.string('Atr','OB Filter Method',     group=grpOB, options=['Atr','Range'])
obMitigation    = input.string('High/Low','OB Mitigation',   group=grpOB, options=['Close','High/Low'])

// ── Equal Highs/Lows ─────────────────────────────────────────
showEQL         = input.bool(true,  'Show Equal H/L',        group=grpEQ)
eqlLength       = input.int(3,      'EQL Confirm Bars',      group=grpEQ, minval=1)
eqlThresh       = input.float(0.1,  'EQL Threshold',         group=grpEQ, minval=0, maxval=0.5, step=0.1)

// ── Premium/Discount ─────────────────────────────────────────
showPD          = input.bool(true,  'Show P/D Zones',        group=grpPD)

// ── IBT Signals ───────────────────────────────────────────────
showSignals     = input.bool(true,  'Show IBT Entry Signals',group=grpSig)
aClassOnly      = input.bool(false, 'A-Class Only (BAG/CFVG)',group=grpSig)
sweepReqd       = input.bool(true,  'Require Liquidity Sweep',group=grpSig)
sweepMem        = input.int(4,      'Sweep Memory (bars)',    group=grpSig, minval=1, maxval=10)
minScore        = input.int(4,      'Min Signal Score (0-9)',group=grpSig, minval=0, maxval=9)
showScore       = input.bool(true,  'Show Score Labels',     group=grpSig)
showTable       = input.bool(true,  'Show Info Table',       group=grpSig)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// COLORS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C_BULL  = colorMode == 'Colored' ? #1D9E75 : #b2b5be
C_BEAR  = colorMode == 'Colored' ? #E24B4A : #5d606b
C_BAG   = color.new(#1D9E75, 72)
C_FVG   = color.new(#378ADD, 78)
C_CFVG  = color.new(#9FE1CB, 72)
C_MG    = color.new(#E24B4A, 78)
C_OB_B  = color.new(#3179f5, 80)
C_OB_R  = color.new(#f77c80, 80)
C_EQL   = #888780
C_PREM  = color.new(#E24B4A, 80)
C_DISC  = color.new(#1D9E75, 80)
C_EQ    = color.new(#888780, 80)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 2 — LUXALGO STRUCTURAL ENGINE (adapted)
//  Full credit: © LuxAlgo | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
//  Source: tradingview.com/v/CnB3fSph/
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Pivot leg detection (LuxAlgo) ────────────────────────────
leg(size) =>
    var int _leg = 0
    if high[size] > ta.highest(size)
        _leg := 0
    else if low[size] < ta.lowest(size)
        _leg := 1
    _leg

// ── Volatility measure for OB filtering (LuxAlgo) ────────────
atrVal          = ta.atr(200)
cumRange        = ta.cum(ta.tr) / bar_index
volMeasure      = obFilter == 'Atr' ? atrVal : cumRange
highVolBar      = (high - low) >= 2 * volMeasure
parsedHigh_OB   = highVolBar ? low  : high
parsedLow_OB    = highVolBar ? high : low

// ── Swing pivot tracking ─────────────────────────────────────
var float swHigh = na
var float swLow  = na
var int   swHighTime = na
var int   swLowTime  = na
var int   swHighBar  = na
var int   swLowBar   = na
var bool  swHighCrossed = false
var bool  swLowCrossed  = false

var float inHigh = na
var float inLow  = na
var int   inHighTime = na
var int   inLowTime  = na
var int   inHighBar  = na
var int   inLowBar   = na
var bool  inHighCrossed = false
var bool  inLowCrossed  = false

// Swing trend state
var int swTrend = 0  // 1=bull, -1=bear
var int inTrend = 0

// Trailing extremes for Strong/Weak H/L and P/D zones
var float trailTop    = na
var float trailBot    = na
var int   trailTopTime   = na
var int   trailBotTime   = na
var int   trailTopBar    = na
var int   trailBotBar    = na

// Process swing pivots
swingLeg        = leg(swingsLen)
swingNewPivot   = ta.change(swingLeg) != 0
swingPivotLow   = ta.change(swingLeg) == 1
swingPivotHigh  = ta.change(swingLeg) == -1

if swingNewPivot
    if swingPivotLow
        swLow         := low[swingsLen]
        swLowTime     := time[swingsLen]
        swLowBar      := bar_index[swingsLen]
        swLowCrossed  := false
        trailBot      := swLow
        trailBotTime  := swLowTime
        trailBotBar   := swLowBar
        if showSwingPts
            label.new(swLowTime, swLow, swLow < nz(swLow[1], swLow) ? 'LL' : 'HL', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)
    else
        swHigh        := high[swingsLen]
        swHighTime    := time[swingsLen]
        swHighBar     := bar_index[swingsLen]
        swHighCrossed := false
        trailTop      := swHigh
        trailTopTime  := swHighTime
        trailTopBar   := swHighBar
        if showSwingPts
            label.new(swHighTime, swHigh, swHigh > nz(swHigh[1], swHigh) ? 'HH' : 'LH', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)

// Process internal pivots (size=5, LuxAlgo default)
inLeg           = leg(5)
inNewPivot      = ta.change(inLeg) != 0
inPivotLow      = ta.change(inLeg) == 1
inPivotHigh     = ta.change(inLeg) == -1

if inNewPivot
    if inPivotLow
        if na(swLow) or low[5] != swLow
            inLow         := low[5]
            inLowTime     := time[5]
            inLowBar      := bar_index[5]
            inLowCrossed  := false
    else
        if na(swHigh) or high[5] != swHigh
            inHigh        := high[5]
            inHighTime    := time[5]
            inHighBar     := bar_index[5]
            inHighCrossed := false

// Update trailing extremes
if not na(high)
    trailTop  := math.max(high, nz(trailTop, high))
    trailBot  := math.min(low,  nz(trailBot, low))
    if trailTop == high
        trailTopTime := time
        trailTopBar  := bar_index
    if trailBot == low
        trailBotTime := time
        trailBotBar  := bar_index

// ── BOS / CHoCH Detection (LuxAlgo logic) ────────────────────
var line   bosLine   = na
var label  bosLabel  = na

// Swing BOS/CHoCH
bosBull  = false
bosBear  = false
chochBull = false
chochBear = false

if not na(swHigh) and not swHighCrossed and ta.crossover(close, swHigh)
    tag       = swTrend == -1 ? 'CHoCH' : 'BOS'
    chochBull := tag == 'CHoCH'
    bosBull   := tag == 'BOS'
    swHighCrossed := true
    swTrend   := 1
    if showBOS
        line.new(swHighTime, swHigh, time, swHigh, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL, style=line.style_solid)
        label.new(time, swHigh, tag, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
    // Store order block on bullish BOS
    if showOB
        obBullBar := bar_index[1]

if not na(swLow) and not swLowCrossed and ta.crossunder(close, swLow)
    tag       = swTrend == 1 ? 'CHoCH' : 'BOS'
    chochBear := tag == 'CHoCH'
    bosBear   := tag == 'BOS'
    swLowCrossed := true
    swTrend   := -1
    if showBOS
        line.new(swLowTime, swLow, time, swLow, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR, style=line.style_solid)
        label.new(time, swLow, tag, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

// Internal BOS/CHoCH
inBosBull  = false
inBosBear  = false
inChochBull = false
inChochBear = false

if not na(inHigh) and not inHighCrossed and ta.crossover(close, inHigh) and inHigh != swHigh
    tag        = inTrend == -1 ? 'CHoCH' : 'BOS'
    inChochBull := tag == 'CHoCH'
    inBosBull  := tag == 'BOS'
    inHighCrossed := true
    inTrend    := 1
    if showInternal
        line.new(inHighTime, inHigh, time, inHigh, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(time, inHigh, tag, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)

if not na(inLow) and not inLowCrossed and ta.crossunder(close, inLow) and inLow != swLow
    tag        = inTrend == 1 ? 'CHoCH' : 'BOS'
    inChochBear := tag == 'CHoCH'
    inBosBear  := tag == 'BOS'
    inLowCrossed := true
    inTrend    := -1
    if showInternal
        line.new(inLowTime, inLow, time, inLow, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR, style=line.style_dashed)
        label.new(time, inLow, tag, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)

// ── Order Blocks (LuxAlgo logic) ─────────────────────────────
var obBullBar  = 0
var obBearBar  = 0

// Store OB index on BOS
if bosBull or inBosBull
    obBullBar := bar_index
if bosBear or inBosBear
    obBearBar := bar_index

// Track OB zones
var array<int>   obBullBars  = array.new<int>()
var array<float> obBullHi    = array.new<float>()
var array<float> obBullLo    = array.new<float>()
var array<int>   obBearBars  = array.new<int>()
var array<float> obBearHi    = array.new<float>()
var array<float> obBearLo    = array.new<float>()

if showOB and (bosBull or inBosBull) and bar_index > 1
    array.unshift(obBullBars, bar_index[1])
    array.unshift(obBullHi,   parsedHigh_OB[1])
    array.unshift(obBullLo,   parsedLow_OB[1])
    if array.size(obBullBars) > obCount
        array.pop(obBullBars)
        array.pop(obBullHi)
        array.pop(obBullLo)

if showOB and (bosBear or inBosBear) and bar_index > 1
    array.unshift(obBearBars, bar_index[1])
    array.unshift(obBearHi,   parsedHigh_OB[1])
    array.unshift(obBearLo,   parsedLow_OB[1])
    if array.size(obBearBars) > obCount
        array.pop(obBearBars)
        array.pop(obBearHi)
        array.pop(obBearLo)

// Draw OB boxes (most recent only, at last bar)
var array<box> bullOBBoxes = array.new<box>()
var array<box> bearOBBoxes = array.new<box>()

if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory or barstate.islast
    for b in bullOBBoxes
        box.delete(b)
    for b in bearOBBoxes
        box.delete(b)
    array.clear(bullOBBoxes)
    array.clear(bearOBBoxes)
    if showOB
        for i = 0 to math.min(obCount - 1, array.size(obBullBars) - 1)
            bIdx  = array.get(obBullBars, i)
            bHi   = array.get(obBullHi, i)
            bLo   = array.get(obBullLo, i)
            mitigated = low <= bHi and (obMitigation == 'Close' ? close < bLo : low < bLo)
            if not mitigated
                b = box.new(bIdx, bHi, bar_index + 5, bLo, border_color=C_OB_B, bgcolor=C_OB_B)
                array.push(bullOBBoxes, b)
        for i = 0 to math.min(obCount - 1, array.size(obBearBars) - 1)
            bIdx  = array.get(obBearBars, i)
            bHi   = array.get(obBearHi, i)
            bLo   = array.get(obBearLo, i)
            mitigated = high >= bLo and (obMitigation == 'Close' ? close > bHi : high > bHi)
            if not mitigated
                b = box.new(bIdx, bHi, bar_index + 5, bLo, border_color=C_OB_R, bgcolor=C_OB_R)
                array.push(bearOBBoxes, b)

// ── Equal Highs / Equal Lows (LuxAlgo logic) ─────────────────
eqlHigh = pivot(na, na, false)
eqlLow  = pivot(na, na, false)

eqlLeg      = leg(eqlLength)
eqlNewPivot = ta.change(eqlLeg) != 0
eqlPivotLow = ta.change(eqlLeg) == 1
eqlPivotHi  = ta.change(eqlLeg) == -1

var float lastEqlHigh = na
var float lastEqlLow  = na
var int   lastEqlHighTime = na
var int   lastEqlLowTime  = na
var int   lastEqlHighBar  = na
var int   lastEqlLowBar   = na

eqlDetectedHigh = false
eqlDetectedLow  = false

if showEQL and eqlNewPivot
    if eqlPivotHi
        if not na(lastEqlHigh) and math.abs(lastEqlHigh - high[eqlLength]) < eqlThresh * atrVal
            line.new(lastEqlHighTime, lastEqlHigh, time[eqlLength], high[eqlLength], xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR, style=line.style_dotted)
            lp = math.round((lastEqlHighBar + bar_index[eqlLength]) / 2)
            label.new(lp, lastEqlHigh, 'EQH', color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
            eqlDetectedHigh := true
        lastEqlHigh     := high[eqlLength]
        lastEqlHighTime := time[eqlLength]
        lastEqlHighBar  := bar_index[eqlLength]
    if eqlPivotLow
        if not na(lastEqlLow) and math.abs(lastEqlLow - low[eqlLength]) < eqlThresh * atrVal
            line.new(lastEqlLowTime, lastEqlLow, time[eqlLength], low[eqlLength], xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL, style=line.style_dotted)
            lp = math.round((lastEqlLowBar + bar_index[eqlLength]) / 2)
            label.new(lp, lastEqlLow, 'EQL', color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)
            eqlDetectedLow := true
        lastEqlLow     := low[eqlLength]
        lastEqlLowTime := time[eqlLength]
        lastEqlLowBar  := bar_index[eqlLength]

// ── Strong / Weak High/Low (LuxAlgo) ─────────────────────────
if showStrWeak and barstate.islast and not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot)
    rightBar = last_bar_time + 20 * (time - time[1])
    line.new(trailTopTime, trailTop, rightBar, trailTop, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BEAR)
    label.new(rightBar, trailTop, swTrend == -1 ? 'Strong High' : 'Weak High', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BEAR, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny)
    line.new(trailBotTime, trailBot, rightBar, trailBot, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=C_BULL)
    label.new(rightBar, trailBot, swTrend == 1 ? 'Strong Low' : 'Weak Low', xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=color(na), textcolor=C_BULL, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.tiny)

// ── Premium / Discount Zones (LuxAlgo) ───────────────────────
if showPD and not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot) and barstate.islast
    eqLvl   = math.avg(trailTop, trailBot)
    premTop = trailTop
    premBot = 0.95*trailTop + 0.05*trailBot
    discTop = 0.95*trailBot + 0.05*trailTop
    discBot = trailBot
    eqTop   = 0.525*trailTop + 0.475*trailBot
    eqBot   = 0.525*trailBot + 0.475*trailTop
    rBar    = last_bar_time
    box.new(trailTopBar, premTop, bar_index+10, premBot, bgcolor=C_PREM, border_color=color(na))
    box.new(trailTopBar, eqTop,   bar_index+10, eqBot,   bgcolor=C_EQ,   border_color=color(na))
    box.new(trailTopBar, discTop, bar_index+10, discBot, bgcolor=C_DISC, border_color=color(na))
    lp = math.round(0.5 * (trailTopBar + last_bar_index))
    label.new(lp, premTop, 'Premium',     color=color(na), textcolor=#E24B4A, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.tiny)
    label.new(lp, eqLvl,  'Equilibrium', color=color(na), textcolor=#888780,  style=label.style_label_left,  size=size.tiny)
    label.new(lp, discBot,'Discount',     color=color(na), textcolor=#1D9E75, style=label.style_label_up,   size=size.tiny)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 3 — IBT GAP DETECTION ENGINE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Gap threshold using LuxAlgo's ATR-based auto-threshold
barDeltaPct = (close - open) / (open * 100)
cumThresh   = fvgAutoThresh ? ta.cum(math.abs(barDeltaPct)) / bar_index * 2 : 0.0

// ── BAG: Body breaks prior extreme ───────────────────────────
bullBAG = low > high[2] and close[1] > high[2]
bearBAG = high < low[2] and close[1] < low[2]

// Double BAG detection
doubleBullBAG = bullBAG and low[1] > high[3] and close[2] > high[3]
doubleBearBAG = bearBAG and high[1] < low[3] and close[2] < low[3]
validBullBAG  = bullBAG and not doubleBullBAG
validBearBAG  = bearBAG and not doubleBearBAG

// ── FVG: Gap exists, wick only ────────────────────────────────
bullFVGraw = low > high[2] and not bullBAG
bearFVGraw = high < low[2] and not bearBAG

// ── CFVG: Color change on FVG ────────────────────────────────
bullCFVG = bullFVGraw and close > open and close[1] < open[1]
bearCFVG = bearFVGraw and close < open and close[1] > open[1]
cleanBullFVG = bullFVGraw and not bullCFVG
cleanBearFVG = bearFVGraw and not bearCFVG

// ── Impulse / Manipulation Gap detection ─────────────────────
impulseUp = close[1]>open[1] and close[2]>open[2] and close[3]>open[3] and close[4]>open[4]
impulseDn = close[1]<open[1] and close[2]<open[2] and close[3]<open[3] and close[4]<open[4]
isMG      = (bullBAG and impulseUp) or (bearBAG and impulseDn)

// ── Gap background colors ─────────────────────────────────────
bgcolor(showBAG  and validBullBAG and not isMG  ? color.new(C_BAG,  85) : na, title='Bull BAG')
bgcolor(showBAG  and validBearBAG and not isMG  ? color.new(C_BAG,  85) : na, title='Bear BAG')
bgcolor(showCFVG and (bullCFVG or bearCFVG)     ? color.new(C_CFVG, 80) : na, title='CFVG')
bgcolor(showFVG  and (cleanBullFVG or cleanBearFVG) ? color.new(C_FVG, 88) : na, title='FVG')
bgcolor(showMG   and isMG                       ? color.new(C_MG,   80) : na, title='MG Skip')
bgcolor(doubleBullBAG or doubleBearBAG          ? color.new(#888780, 85): na, title='Double BAG Wait')

// ─── MG marker ───────────────────────────────────────────────
plotshape(showMG and isMG, title='MG Skip', location=location.abovebar, color=#E24B4A, style=shape.xcross, size=size.small, text='MG')

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 4 — LIQUIDITY SWEEP DETECTION (IBT)
//  Valid sweep: wick pierces swing level + body closes back
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Use LuxAlgo's swing pivots for sweep reference
bullSweep = not na(swLow)  and low  < swLow  and close > swLow
bearSweep = not na(swHigh) and high > swHigh and close < swHigh

// IFC candle: large wick, tiny body (< 25% of range)
bodySize  = math.abs(close - open)
rangeSize = high - low
ifcShape  = rangeSize > 0 and (bodySize / rangeSize) < 0.25 and rangeSize > atrVal * 0.8
bullIFC   = ifcShape and low < low[1] and close > open
bearIFC   = ifcShape and high > high[1] and close < open

// Sweep memory: any sweep in last N bars
bullSweepRecent = ta.barssince(bullSweep) <= sweepMem
bearSweepRecent = ta.barssince(bearSweep) <= sweepMem

// Ranging: both sweeps active recently = skip
ranging = bullSweepRecent and bearSweepRecent

// Sweep markers
plotshape(bullSweep, title='Bull Sweep', location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(#534AB7,0), style=shape.triangleup,   size=size.tiny, text='SW↑')
plotshape(bearSweep, title='Bear Sweep', location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(#534AB7,0), style=shape.triangledown, size=size.tiny, text='SW↓')
plotshape(bullIFC and bullSweep, title='Bull IFC', location=location.belowbar, color=#534AB7, style=shape.diamond, size=size.small, text='IFC')
plotshape(bearIFC and bearSweep, title='Bear IFC', location=location.abovebar, color=#534AB7, style=shape.diamond, size=size.small, text='IFC')

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 5 — PREMIUM / DISCOUNT ZONE HELPER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pdMid     = not na(trailTop) and not na(trailBot) ? math.avg(trailTop, trailBot) : na
inDiscount = not na(pdMid) and close < pdMid
inPremium  = not na(pdMid) and close > pdMid

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 6 — ORDER FLOW DIRECTION BIAS
//  Count directional gaps in last 10 bars
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
bullGapCount = 0
bearGapCount = 0
for k = 1 to 10
    if low[k] > high[k+2]
        bullGapCount += 1
    if high[k] < low[k+2]
        bearGapCount += 1

ofDir = bullGapCount > bearGapCount * 1.5 ? 1 : bearGapCount > bullGapCount * 1.5 ? -1 : 0

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 7 — IBT SIGNAL SCORING
//  Score 0-9. Only fire signals above minScore.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// A-class: BAG or CFVG (3 pts), B-class: FVG (1 pt)
bullGapScore = validBullBAG or bullCFVG ? 3 : cleanBullFVG ? 1 : 0
bearGapScore = validBearBAG or bearCFVG ? 3 : cleanBearFVG ? 1 : 0

// Sweep presence (+2 if IFC, +1 if plain sweep)
bullSweepScore = bullSweepRecent ? (bullIFC ? 2 : 1) : 0
bearSweepScore = bearSweepRecent ? (bearIFC ? 2 : 1) : 0

// BOS/CHoCH alignment from LuxAlgo structure engine (+1)
bullStructScore = (bosBull or inBosBull or chochBull or inChochBull) ? 1 : 0
bearStructScore = (bosBear or inBosBear or chochBear or inChochBear) ? 1 : 0

// Premium/Discount zone (+1)
bullPDScore = inDiscount ? 1 : 0
bearPDScore = inPremium  ? 1 : 0

// Order Flow alignment (+1)
bullOFScore = ofDir == 1 ? 1 : 0
bearOFScore = ofDir == -1 ? 1 : 0

// EQL adds urgency context (equal level swept = stronger)
bullEQLScore = eqlDetectedLow and bullSweepRecent ? 1 : 0
bearEQLScore = eqlDetectedHigh and bearSweepRecent ? 1 : 0

// Total scores
bullScore = bullGapScore + bullSweepScore + bullStructScore + bullPDScore + bullOFScore + bullEQLScore
bearScore = bearGapScore + bearSweepScore + bearStructScore + bearPDScore + bearOFScore + bearEQLScore

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECTION 8 — SIGNAL FILTERS & FINAL ENTRY CONDITIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sweepFilter = sweepReqd ? bullSweepRecent : true
aFilter     = aClassOnly ? (validBullBAG or bullCFVG) : (validBullBAG or bullCFVG or cleanBullFVG)

// BUY A-Class: BAG/CFVG + sweep + structural alignment + not MG + not ranging + score
buyA = showSignals
     and (validBullBAG or bullCFVG)
     and bullSweepRecent
     and not isMG and not ranging
     and (swTrend == 1 or inTrend == 1)
     and bullScore >= minScore

// SELL A-Class
sellA = showSignals
      and (validBearBAG or bearCFVG)
      and bearSweepRecent
      and not isMG and not ranging
      and (swTrend == -1 or inTrend == -1)
      and bearScore >= minScore

// BUY B-Class: FVG + sweep + score (if A-class only is off)
buyB = showSignals and not aClassOnly
     and cleanBullFVG
     and bullSweepRecent
     and not isMG and not ranging
     and bullScore >= minScore

// SELL B-Class
sellB = showSignals and not aClassOnly
      and cleanBearFVG
      and bearSweepRecent
      and not isMG and not ranging
      and bearScore >= minScore

// ── Signal labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────
gapTypeBull = validBullBAG ? 'BAG' : bullCFVG ? 'CFVG' : 'FVG'
gapTypeBear = validBearBAG ? 'BAG' : bearCFVG ? 'CFVG' : 'FVG'

if buyA
    l = label.new(bar_index, low, 'BUY\n' + gapTypeBull + (showScore ? '\n★' + str.tostring(bullScore) : ''),
      color=#1D9E75, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.normal)
if sellA
    l = label.new(bar_index, high, 'SELL\n' + gapTypeBear + (showScore ? '\n★' + str.tostring(bearScore) : ''),
      color=#E24B4A, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)
if buyB
    l = label.new(bar_index, low, 'buy\n' + gapTypeBull + (showScore ? '\n' + str.tostring(bullScore) : ''),
      color=color.new(#1D9E75,40), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)
if sellB
    l = label.new(bar_index, high, 'sell\n' + gapTypeBear + (showScore ? '\n' + str.tostring(bearScore) : ''),
      color=color.new(#E24B4A,40), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// Double BAG warning label
if doubleBullBAG or doubleBearBAG
    label.new(bar_index, close, 'Double BAG\nWait 50%', color=color.new(#888780,30), textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.small)

What your current system already does
You are trading a 4‑step IBT (Inducement–BOS–Target) style binary options strategy on 1‑minute forex, with logic based on gaps, liquidity sweeps, and clear targets.

Your strategy.py defines this 4‑step entry flow: Step 1 is a swing liquidity sweep or extreme FVG mitigation, Step 2 is sharp turn or inverse FVG, Step 3 is C‑FVG/BAG/FVG entry gap, and Step 4 requires a clear target before allowing an entry, all tuned via PARAMS such as wick ratio, gap sizes, and target distance.

Marks and Drawings – if you ever host Charting Library, the Marks and Drawings APIs let you overlay shapes, arrows, text, and news markers on specific bars, connecting directly to your Python or AI logic.

3. Strategy‑building with AI & TradingView

Even if you don’t copy their strategies, the workflow – AI suggests changes, TradingView verifies, you keep what works – is the same as your agent_loop.py pipeline.

How to progress from here (practical next steps)
To move toward your goal of being a consistently profitable binary trader with AI guidance, I’d suggest this order:

Start with a minimal version: only Step 1 + Step 2 + a basic target check, no IFC/order‑flow, and verify that the live signals roughly match your Python backtest.

Gradually add extra filters: IDM mitigation, sweep counts, equal highs/lows skip, PD filter, IFC, no‑resistance, and scoring.

Use a strict money‑plan and news filter every day

Build the money‑management sheet described above and follow it like a rulebook, including daily and weekly loss limits.

Pre‑mark high‑impact news on your chart and do not trade in those windows, even if your indicator shows a good‑looking pattern.

Journal and review with the AI assistant

After each session, share a few key trades and your journal data with an AI assistant (like me or Claude), asking: “Did I follow my rules? Was this candle really tradable according to the indicator logic?”

Use this feedback loop to improve both the logic and your discipline.
